data.name: Endless Tower
data.detailed_description:
Endless Tower is a first-person atmospheric exploration game focused on movement, flow, and discovery.

You awaken at the base of a colossal tower whose peak is hidden beyond the clouds. As you climb higher, the world slowly changes — environments grow stranger, paths become more vertical, and the silence begins to speak.

There are no enemies. No combat.
Your challenge is the tower itself.

Traverse carefully crafted biomes, navigate vertical spaces, and uncover subtle environmental storytelling as you ascend. The experience is designed to feel calm yet mysterious, encouraging curiosity rather than pressure.

Key Features

  • 🗼 Vertical Exploration – Climb a massive, seemingly endless tower

  • 🌫️ Atmospheric World – Minimalist visuals, fog, and mood-driven environments

  • 🧭 Discovery-Focused Gameplay – No combat, no enemies, just exploration

  • 🎮 Smooth Movement & Flow – Designed for immersion and traversal

  • 🕯️ Subtle Storytelling – The tower reveals itself quietly as you progress

Each step upward raises a simple question:
What lies at the top — and should it be reached?

  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
